description_en: Queries the settings of the deep packet inspection (DPI) feature for a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 查询智能接入网关实例应用识别DPI（Deep Packet Inspection）功能配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag get-smart-ag-dpi-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-tq3sazs17smldn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSmartAGDpiAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

DpiMonitorStatus.description_en:
The status of the DPI-based monitoring feature. Valid values:

Active: enabled
Inactive: disabled
DpiMonitorStatus.description_zh:
智能接入网关实例DPI监控功能开启状态。

Active：已开启。
Inactive：未开启

DpiStatus.description_en:
The status of the DPI feature. Valid values:

On: enabled
Off: disabled
DpiStatus.description_zh:
智能接入网关实例DPI功能开启状态。

On：已开启。
Off：未开启

LogstoreName.description_en: The name of the Log Service Logstore that is associated with the DPI feature
LogstoreName.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例DPI功能关联的Logstore实例名称

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the Log Service project that is associated with the DPI feature
ProjectName.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例DPI功能关联的Project实例名称

SlsRegion.description_en: The region where Log Service is deployed
SlsRegion.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例DPI功能关联的日志服务的地域
